title: Someone Was Impersonating Her in Online Affairs. She Says It Was Her Husband.

reading.body:
The incident centers on sustained online impersonation of a public figure, in which someone created fake personas using her name and image to engage men in sexual conversations and circulate explicit fabricated material, including a synthetic video depicting her in sexual situations. The failure here is the use of digital tools, including AI-capable image and video fabrication, to produce non-consensual synthetic intimate content and to conduct long-running identity fraud at scale.

The deployment context is not a single platform or product but a pattern of abuse carried out across online spaces over an extended period. The fabricated video points specifically to the use of deepfake or similar generative technology to create material the subject never produced or consented to. No technical checkpoint, platform moderation system, or identity verification process is described as having detected or interrupted the activity during the years it continued.

What is not established: the title names her former husband as the suspected perpetrator, but this is Fernandes's allegation, not a legal finding, and no verdict, charge, or independent confirmation is present in the reporting.

reports.title: Someone Was Impersonating Her in Online Affairs. She Says It Was Her Husband.

summary:
German actress Collien Fernandes discovered that someone had been impersonating her online for years, engaging in sexual conversations with men and sharing explicit material using her name and image. The harassment escalated when she learned about a fabricated video depicting her in sexual situations. Rather than ignore the problem, Fernandes decided to investigate the impersonators herself, taking on the role of a journalist to uncover who was behind the deception. After considerable detective work, she believed she had identified one of the perpetrators and was prepared to publicly expose him.

Fernandes had recently divorced Christian Ulmen, a famous German actor and comedian known for his cringe humor. During their 14-year marriage, the couple was celebrated as a progressive, feminist-minded pair in German media. Fernandes had become an advocate for feminist causes, publishing children's books about gender roles and producing a documentary on feminism. However, beneath this public image, she had endured years of disturbing online harassment that went far beyond typical celebrity trolling, leading her to take personal action to identify and confront her harassers.
